prompt: A locked, washed-out view from a lens high in the corner of a shared bathroom, looking down at Brandon standing at a chipped basin with one arm in a cast, brows pulled together, eyelids heavy, mouth slack, eyes aimed at a dripping tap. His phone is propped against the mirror on the sink's edge, its face turned away as a blur of light. The room has yellowed tiles, a mouldy shower curtain, a bare bulb in a cage, and a pile of towels on a radiator. Colours are bleached and compressed, with grain in the shadows, and nothing is written anywhere on the picture. Thanks.
